answer: Filling a form takes time that grows with the number of fields and the need to think; a human pauses on hard fields and rushes easy ones. The network measures form-fill timing per field and flags a session that fills every field in identical time, because no human thinks at a constant rate. A ledge out of place triggers the check: the session is frozen until its pattern clears. The inlet keeps the process honest and the ocean keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
